Language movement hero Dalil Uddin passes away
2017-11-15T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Dinajpur
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/language-movement-hero-dalil-uddin-passes-away-1491415

Language Movement hero advocate Dalil Uddin passed away at his home in Dinajpur town on Monday evening. He was 83. Born on 15 February, 1935, he played a significant role directly organising the Language Movement.
